# Pablo Cordero — Full-Stack Software Engineer & AI Systems Developer

## Who he is

Pablo Cordero (also known as Pablo Pistola) is a full-stack software engineer and creative technologist based in North Carolina, originally from New York. He specializes in AI systems architecture, LLM orchestration, interactive 3D web experiences, and full-stack product development.

His background is unusual: two decades as a visual artist and draftsman, nearly twenty years as a Spanish interpreter, and a long practice in Okinawan Goju-Ryu martial arts. These disciplines directly shape how he engineers — with an emphasis on structure, clarity, and systems that feel intentional rather than assembled.

Portfolio: https://pvblocordero.com

## What he builds

- **AI systems & LLM architecture** — custom orchestration layers, personality engines, multi-agent routing, archetype-based cognitive systems
- **Interactive 3D web** — Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Blender-to-web pipelines, real-time audio-reactive visuals
- **Full-stack applications** — React, Django, Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, WebSockets
- **Creative technology** — generative art, procedural animation, immersive UI systems

## Selected projects

**Pneuma — AI Personality Engine**
An experimental LLM orchestration architecture. 46 philosophical archetypes selected via 3-layer routing (cosine similarity → momentum weighting → fusion history), forced into dialectical collision across 1,764 pre-mapped tension pairs. Personality evolves across sessions through archetype momentum decay. 3-layer memory: vector embeddings, structured cross-session memory, full conversation persistence. Between sessions, archetypes run private dialectic dialogues that write silently to system state.

**Transcendence — 3D Virtual Pet**
A real-time 3D virtual pet built with Three.js and Blender. Custom-rigged character models, procedural animation, and persistent state. Featured project.

**Nexus Geom Lab — 4D Geometry Explorer**
A gamified platform for manipulating 24 hyperdimensional shapes (tesseracts, quantum manifolds, Hessian polychorons) in real-time WebGL. Audio-reactive visuals via FFT analysis. MongoDB + JWT auth. 93% code reduction from v1 to v2 (2,700 → 199 lines).

**Numeneon — Neopunk Social Platform**
A full-stack social media platform with a 3-column "River Timeline" feed architecture. Built with React and Django. Pablo served as Technical Product Manager and UI Lead on a 4-person team. 40+ organic users, 58% engagement rate, 100% uptime on self-managed cloud infrastructure.

**La Dolce Vita — AI Concierge**
A luxury vacation rental platform for a real client in Las Terrenas, Dominican Republic. AI chatbot powered by GPT-4o-mini with live iCal availability checking, natural language date parsing, multilingual support (EN/ES/FR), and Google Sheets property data integration. React + Vercel + Express + MongoDB.

**INSTVNCE Blog — Neopunk Developer Log**
A self-hosted developer blog with a terminal/monitoring dashboard aesthetic. CRT scanlines, holographic cards, floating 3D metallic braces in WebGL via Three.js. Full Markdown with syntax-highlighted code blocks.
